verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that applications creating transcription jobs can receive completion updates through webhooks, and the Jobs API changelog adds a webhook callback when a job is canceled. That makes these outbound HTTP callbacks for job events that a programmatic consumer can receive. missing for 10: documented callback-URL registration parameter, event payload schema, signature verification and retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Applications create transcription jobs and can receive completion updates through webhooks.
A webhook callback when a job is canceled
